verdict.rationale: Replit is a development platform that could plausibly publish an API spec, so the axis applies. The probe found no OpenAPI or Swagger document at any candidate path, and no evidence item documents a downloadable machine-readable spec. The llms.txt file and the Replit MCP Server are different capabilities and do not count as an API spec.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
